flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 65, P/B 12.6, DCF overvalued 190%. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Capital Goods is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.63) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The management expects to reach the INR 1,000 crore revenue milestone organically within the next 2 years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So if we go organically, probably next 2 years from here, considering our 40%, 50% CAGR growth, as an as assurity from our side, that's what we are heading towards." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Management targets a 40% to 50% CAGR growth trajectory for the coming years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Probably we'll keep our strategy in line with 40%, 50% CAGR growth because next couple of years with this year, I would say, next couple of years, we eyeing on ₹1,000 crores kind of a journey." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company is evaluating suitable acquisition opportunities in Southern India, North America, and Mexico.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "As a part of our strategic expansion, we are also evaluating suitable acquisition opportunities right now in Southern India, maybe in Bangalore or part of that area, and maybe in a North American area, maybe in Mexico." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Construction is ongoing for the greenfield project featuring three verticals: plastic, sheet metal, and wire harness.
